title: Global Well-posedness of Strong Solutions to the Cauchy Problem of 2D Nonhomogeneous Navier-Stokes Equations with Density-Dependent Viscosity and Vacuum
summary: This paper is concerned with the Cauchy problem for the modified two-dimensional (2D) nonhomogeneous incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with density-dependent viscosity. By fully using the structure of the system, we can obtain the key estimates of $\|\nabla ρ\|_{L_t^\infty L_x^q},q>2$ without any smallness asuumption on the initial data, and thus establish the global existence of the strong solutions with the far-field density being either vacuum or nonvacuum.
